name: ourcommunityrituals-workspace
description: Workspace root for OCR shared packages (packages/*). Sibling app repos (OSE, OW, OA, OER, OSM, OSG, OSP, OSR, OCR-docs) are independent git repos and NOT part of this workspace.

scripts.runner-fleet:status: pnpm --filter @ocr/runner-fleet exec node --import tsx/esm src/cli.ts status
scripts.runner-fleet:watch: pnpm --filter @ocr/runner-fleet exec node --import tsx/esm src/cli.ts watch
scripts.runner-fleet:dashboard: pnpm --filter @ocr/runner-fleet exec node --import tsx/esm src/cli.ts dashboard
scripts.runner-fleet:bounce: pnpm --filter @ocr/runner-fleet exec node --import tsx/esm src/cli.ts bounce
scripts.runner-fleet:register: pnpm --filter @ocr/runner-fleet exec node --import tsx/esm src/cli.ts register
